title: Unauthorized Charges & Misleading interface
body:
I strongly advise against downloading this app. The interface is confusing, and there’s no clear way to cancel a subscription from within the app. I wrote directly to Ultiself on June 13, 2025, requesting cancellation, but they still charged my card afterward in September.

When I contacted support again, they only confirmed cancellation as of today and refused to refund the unauthorized charge. This feels deceptive and unfair.

An app should be transparent, easy to use, and respectful of customers’ requests. Instead, I’ve had to spend unnecessary time disputing charges that should never have happened.

Save yourself the trouble and avoid this app.

title: Relies on your own willpower. No science behind it.
body:
An absolute barrage of impossible-to-follow psychobabble filled with ads for liver cleansing products. Nothing intuitive or helpful about it.

Firstly, the number of "ad-ons" we are prompted to buy is overwhelming. Secondly, I didn't appreciate the insidious nature of the messages we had to click in order to say, "no thanks". What I mean by that is that every time you click that you don't want the $59 milk thistle or whatever liver concoction you're selling (by the way, clinical trials of milk thistle have produced very mixed results. There is ZERO conclusive evidence it helps your liver at all), the "no thanks" button is actually a "no I do not wish to improve my health" (or wording to that effect) button.

Then there is the app and Optimal Routine PDF. All of it relies on self-entering data based on the will power and initiative of the very person who has shown no will power to stop drinking. There is not a scintilla of evidence-based or scientific approach to reforming the behaviour of someone who would like to reduce their drinking. 

You could literally grab an A4 piece of paper, draw up a table and tally up how many times you've "hydrated", "socialized" or "engaged in deep breathing". Those things (socializing, deep breathing, sleeping, water) do work, but the app does nothing to actually help you modify your habits. It's essentially an app that says, "hey, you should change your habits". I'd rather pay my wife that money to tell me that, while I get a little crayon and mark it on the wall.

body:
Don’t get fooled like I did: I saw their ad on Instagram, I took their test, etc., then I signed up for a free trial which I immediately canceled right after (like I always do with other apps when there’s a free trial).

But to my surprise, I was still charged around €50, which is not normal because they are only supposed to take the card details and charge you only if the trial continues.

The following month, I noticed a withdrawal of about €75, even though after checking I had no active subscription on the app. I hadn’t even used it once anyway, because it’s completely useless. So I basically got ROBBED of more than €100 by this app. I want to stress that at NO point did I agree to pay for anything.

Of course, during this time I sent them about 4 emails demanding a refund, but of course they never replied. In short, don’t download this app, it’s just an AI created to steal money from people during sign-up, and they even keep your card afterwards to keep charging you (by the way, the €75 was taken with no invoice and no explanation at all).

body: В приложении есть проблемы с подпиской , покупая короткий курс вы не подразумеваете , что пойдет автоматическое продление. title: They stole my money
body:
I am writing this review to warn everyone about this predatory application. My experience has been a complete nightmare, and it seems I'm not alone.

It all started with an online ad offering a trial for a small fee. I signed up to test it but quickly realized the app was not for me. The critical mistake was assuming I could easily cancel.

Here is their scam in action:

1. No Cancellation Option: There is NO button to cancel the subscription inside the app itself. They only provide a link to the App Store, which, for many users, DOES NOT show their active subscription. This is a deliberate dead-end.
2. Silent & Massive Overcharge: I initially paid a small trial fee. A month later, without any further authorization from me, they charged my card $50 for a "monthly subscription" I never wanted or approved. This is theft.
3. Ignored Support: As others have reported, their customer support is a ghost town. They completely ignore requests to cancel subscriptions and refund stolen money.

To the developer: Ignoring your customers and designing a system to make cancellation impossible is not a business model, it's fraud.

To potential users: Stay far away. Your money and peace of mind are not safe here. I am now forced to contact my bank to dispute these fraudulent charges and report this app to Apple.

title: Grandiosa con mucho potencial de mejora
body:
En tanto vi el anuncio y ahondé en el concepto me hice con la versión premium y no puedo estar más agradecido. Sin embargo veo varios puntos susceptibles de una gran mejora y por eso doy 4 estrellas en lugar de 5. Por ejemplo la gráfica de estadísticas podría expandirse al toque para ver el registro más allá de los últimos 3 meses. También podrían implementar un lenguaje de color mas dinámico en la linea de esta grafica para indicar cuando la semana va en curso y va ascendiendo hasta que esta completada, (tal vez un degradado funcione)
En cuanto a los hábitos añadidos por uno mismo sería bueno poder agregar un icono personalizado así como poder cambiar el nombre en cualquier momento sin necesidad de tener que crear uno nuevo… Así como estos pequeños detalles he pensado en varios mas conforme uso la app pero estos son algunos de los principales que me gustaría mejoraran. Ánimo y adelante! es una gran idea y estoy feliz de poder usarla. Muchas gracias

title: Por error compre la app mediante Apple Pay y me siguen cobrando.
body:
Hice la compra por error mediante Apple Pay, de $14 aproximadamente, al entender mi error descargue el app para utilizarla mientras se vencía la membresía que ya había pagado. Para mi sorpresa, me hicieron un rebajo de $39,72 que no autorice ni fui notificada previamente para poder cancelar. No tengo mayor detalle de este cobro ni se me ha explicado lo que cubre. No me interesa la app, nunca la usé. No se me refleja como una compra mediante App Store por lo que no puedo solicitar un reembolso, sino que se refleja directamente en mi cuenta bancaria y debo gestionar la queja mediante mi banco. Muy inseguro, no entiendo porque guardaron mi información de Apple Pay. 
Apple tampoco me da solución.

Действительно, приложение при установке и запуске бесплатного периода по подписке, предлагает определённый набор прописных истин из интернета, но только после того, как прогоняет вас через 15 продуктов дополнительных, от каждого из которых отказаться крайние неочевидно. Более того, пользоваться непосредственно даже платным подписным продуктам у вас получится только после прохождения этого всего. Очевидной отписки от них нет, только через письмо на общий почтовый ящик, который никогда не отвечает. С карты, которую привязываешь через App Store, проходит только бесплатная подписка, естественно не отображается в списке подписок App Store. Все покупки в приложении проходят в обход App Store и соответственно никак не могут быть остановлены отменой подписки или запретом в App Store. Как подобное приложение и модель работы до сих пор (а судя по отзывам - уже больше года) может открыто существовать и присутствовать в App Store непонятно.

title: UltiSelf Review – A Major Disappointment and Warning
body:
UltiSelf is one of those apps that seems promising at first glance, but quickly turns into a frustrating and deceptive experience. The app aggressively pushes users to enter their credit card information with the promise of a trial period — but without any proper notification, it charges your account. Even worse, the subscription doesn’t appear under your Apple subscriptions, making it extremely difficult to locate or cancel.

The lack of transparency is alarming, and the entire approach feels unethical. The content and features of the app are also underwhelming — there is little to no value compared to many free habit-tracking alternatives available.

I do not recommend this app. It feels like a money trap disguised as a productivity tool. If you’re serious about self-improvement, look elsewhere.

⭐ 1/5 – I’d give zero stars if I could.

title: Нечестные методы списания: Ultiself пытается снять деньги без явного согласия

Такой подход вызывает серьезные вопросы к честности разработчиков. Пользователи должны четко понимать условия использования приложения, включая стоимость, еще до его установки.

Отказался от использования приложения, запросил отмену подписки и удаление аккаунта. Ожидаю реакции, но пока впечатления крайне негативные.

title: They stole my money
body:
I installed this app in around December 2023 thinking it looks good and could help me build up some better routine. But after paying 10 dollars for short term acces I realised the offer is pretty bad for the huge sums of money so I unsubscribed from any products offered and deleted the app. Couple days ago I got charged by this company whole $49 dollars as mobile service recharge???? I do pay my mobile phone in my own country’s currency and not in dollars and not to a company called Ultiself. So this was very sneaky way of attempting to charge me and hoping I would not notice. I did contact their support about it and received no info. Bear in mind — I did not receive any receipt from them nor did I get any product inside of their app after I downloaded this waste of disk space again. I am overly disapointed and by the pettiness of this company to attempt such theft. And I want to warn everyone not to give them any card info or even download this.

Edit (response to the developer response): I did contact your support and received zero response. I checked the lists of owned subscriptions or purchased products in the apple support multiple time during the last week. There is no product received. 

By also checking your trust pilot reviews this is not the first time these “accidental” charges happened.

title: Enttäuschend – überteuert und unnötig komplex
body:
Ich habe die App ausprobiert und war insgesamt enttäuscht. Der Preis steht in keinem Verhältnis zum gebotenen Mehrwert. Die Benutzeroberfläche wirkt altmodisch und ist wenig ansprechend gestaltet.

Viele der angebotenen Funktionen, wie das Erstellen von Routinen oder das Verfolgen von Gewohnheiten, lassen sich mit den Bordmitteln moderner Smartphones (z. B. Erinnerungen, Kalender, Notizen) genauso gut – wenn nicht besser – umsetzen. Auch die “Kurse” oder Empfehlungen, die als Premium-Inhalte verkauft werden, lassen sich mit etwas Eigeninitiative und Tools wie ChatGPT problemlos selbst erarbeiten – individuell und kostenlos.

Mein Fazit: Die App vermittelt den Eindruck, mehr zu bieten als sie tatsächlich tut. Ich kann sie nicht empfehlen und rate jedem, sich vor dem Abschluss eines kostenpflichtigen Abos gut zu überlegen, ob der tatsächliche Nutzen den Preis rechtfertigt.

title: Vorsicht! - Intransparente Abo-Abzocke!
body:
Premiumzugang für €23 gekauft & drei Monate später um weitere €66,65 erleichtert. Letzteres ohne jeden vorherigen Hinweis auf ein Abo oder Ankündigung.

Dabei fand ich die App bereits nach der Hälfte der Zeit schon so nervig, dass ich sie gar nicht mehr genutzt habe. - Besonders das konsequent „falsche Deutsch“ hat „meinen inneren Monk“ derart auf Trab gehalten, dass dies die eigentlich zu unterstützende Entspannung im Alltag zunehmend gestört hat. - Die €23 empfand ich inzwischen als ziemlich „rausgeschmissen“.

Und dann auch noch diese unverschämte Abomasche!
Nun habe ich sofort - noch am gleichen Tag - auf die unauthorisierte Abbuchung reagiert & dieser widersprochen. Doch weder UltiSelf noch Paypal nehmen sich davon etwas an.

UltiSelf behauptet, beim Bezahlvorgang auf das Abo hinzuweisen. Wenn dies so wäre, hätte ich den Kauf jedoch gar nicht getätigt!
Und selbst wenn, wäre dies an dieser Stelle bereits intransparent genug, als dass es (nach deutscher Rechtsprechung) noch rechtens wäre!

Wenn ich mir andere Rezensionen über dieses „freundliche“ Unternehmen ansehe, darf ich wohl gespannt sein, ob die inzwischen wenigstens bestätigte Abo-Kündigung für UltiSelf ausreichend verbindlich ist, um nicht trotzdem erneut unauthorisierte Abbuchungen von meinem Paypal-Konto zu veranlassen!?! …

FAZIT: Finger weg!

title: Great Start
body:
The general idea of the app is great and there’s finally a habit tracker that doesn’t only tell you how often you’ve completed a habit but how effective each habit is for you personally. This is something I’ve missed in other apps. Plus, there’s a large library of habits plus corresponding sources why they are effective in the app. However, there’s one thing that prevent me from giving it five stars: 

There’s currently no option of tracking symptoms (eg headache etc.) and flagging a day as sick day. For example, if I’m I’ll today, I won’t be as energetic, productive, … but that’s mainly because I’m sick rather than because the habits aren’t working. It would be great to have a way of excluding these days from the analysis or at least marking them somehow in the app. This is especially important for women when they have their period. 

Some other improvements I’d love to see are:
1) Ability to link to third party apps/devices like Garmin and sleep tracker apps
2) Ability to access next day in the journal (not only today) because I like to set my MIT a day in advance
3) Ability to customize and/or add performance metrics (eg being able to rename “Health” to “Energy” or introducing a completely separate rating for “Energy”)
4) Ability to export your own data (eg as Excel file) to perform additional analysis 

Maybe there’s even a roadmap you can share publicly at some point? I also sincerely hope that you don’t abandon this project like it happened with other habit trackers because I love the idea behind Ultiself and hope to use it for a long time coming! For now, I really appreciate that the Ultiself team seems to be constantly working on and improving the app and I’m looking forward to it becoming even more effective! Thanks!

Tod@s sabemos lo importante que es la salud y principalmente la mental y la verdad es que creemos que podemos con todo de forma autónoma, pero en realidad no es así. 
Tod@s necesitamos adquirir y aprender esas herramientas para poder estar y sentirnos mejor, gracias a personas como MICHAEL, no solo aprendes sino que te enseñan a hacerlo sostenible en el tiempo y eso es lo más importante.
Os invito a que probeis, no os arrepentiréis, Lo recomiendo al 100%!
Gracias por tanto en tan poco tiempo!!
Vamos a por nuestra mejor versión 🤝

Saludos

title: Skam
body:
I was charged without my consent and without any notification. I never agreed to any subscription, yet money was debited from my card multiple times. There is NO active subscription visible in my App Store account, which proves these charges are unauthorized.
Even worse, the app stored my payment card without permission and provides NO way to view or delete it. I cannot find where my card is saved or how to remove it. This is a serious privacy and security violation.
Customer support is unresponsive. The company deliberately hides payment management options to trap users into recurring charges they never agreed to.
DO NOT USE THIS APP. Scam company with predatory billing practices.

title: Énorme arnaque
body:
⚠️ Expérience scandaleuse – Application à fuir ⚠️

Je suis extrêmement surpris qu’Apple laisse ce type d’application sur l’App Store.

J’ai souscrit à une offre à 9,92 € et, sans aucune validation claire ni consentement explicite, j’ai été débité de 57€ via Apple Pay. Aucune confirmation d’achat, aucun récapitulatif : rien.

Après vérification, je constate que je ne suis pas un cas isolé. Des centaines d’utilisateurs signalent des prélèvements abusifs répétés et des difficultés à résilier, même après contact avec la société.

Ce type de pratique est inacceptable et n’a rien à faire sur une plateforme comme l’App Store, censée protéger ses utilisateurs.

Je demande à Apple de :
	•	Vérifier immédiatement cette application
	•	Prendre des mesures contre ces pratiques
	•	Et surtout protéger les utilisateurs contre ce genre d’abus

En l’état, je déconseille fortement cette application.

À fuir

title: Pratique opaque concernant l’annulation et la gestion de l’abonnement
body:
Avis en Français :

Je déconseille fortement cette application. J’ai souscrit à une offre annoncée à 15 $ pour 4 semaines, mais j’ai été facturée 55 €. Une fois l’application téléchargée, elle indique qu’elle “ne fonctionne pas aujourd’hui”, ce qui est déjà inadmissible.

De plus, il est impossible de gérer ou de résilier l’abonnement via l’App Store (Apple) ou le Play Store, car l’application n’apparaît pas dans la liste des abonnements. Cela force les utilisateurs à contacter leur support par email pour gérer leur abonnement, une méthode très opaque et loin des standards habituels des plateformes respectées.

Enfin, tout est conçu pour rendre la gestion ou l’annulation complexe. Il s’agit clairement d’une pratique trompeuse.

Apple, soyez vigilants sur les applications que vous autorisez ! Ce genre de fonctionnement nuit gravement à votre réputation.

Review in English:

I strongly advise against using this app. I subscribed to a plan advertised as $15 for 4 weeks, but I was charged €55 instead. After downloading the app, it simply states that it’s “not working today,” which is completely unacceptable.

Furthermore, it’s impossible to manage or cancel the subscription via the App Store (Apple) or Play Store, as the app does not appear in the subscription list. This forces users to contact support via email to handle their subscription—a very opaque and non-standard practice.

Finally, everything seems intentionally designed to make subscription management or cancellation unnecessarily difficult. This is clearly misleading.

Apple, please pay attention to the apps you allow on your platform! Practices like this severely damage your credibility.

title: Supercherie et publicité mensongère
body:
Faites très attention avec cette offre d’essai gratuit de 7 jours car une fois que vous souscrivez vous ne pourriez pas vous rétracter même après 24h pour ce qui est mon cas car après souscription et revue de l’application je constate que j’ai déjà une appli qui remplie les mêmes fonctions et même plus. Mais après 2 réclamations adressées au services d’abonnements Apple et même au service client de L’appli (Apple a rejeté mes 2 demandes de résiliation et remboursement alors que les 7 jours courent toujours l’abonnement expire le 6 janvier 2024) 
Et Attention, lisez bien la section ABONNEMENT ET CONFIDENTIALITÉ 
Il est écrit que si vous ne renouveler pas votre abonnement au bout de 180 jours votre identifiant pour cette appli sera réinitialisé ( Ceci n’est pas très claire car il est difficile de savoir si cette réinitialisation implique un réabonnement sans votre consentement ?)

Je suis déçue et choquée par ce type de publicité mensongère. Je suis à 3 jours de l’essai gratuit. Malgré que j’ai résilier le renouvellement de cette abonnement, rien ne me garantie que je ne serai pas renouvelée sous prétexte que c’est un abonnement automatique annuel. 

Pour ma part, je souhaite que Apple ou l’équipe en charge de l’application désactive tout simplement et définitivement cet abonnement car je ne l’utiliserai pas pendant cette année d’abonnement forcé. Gardez les frais d’abonnement si vous voulez mais de grâce supprimer mes paramètres de cet application avant que je ne l’efface de mon téléphone. J’ai pas envie de devoir payer l’an prochain pour une application qui n’existe plus sur mon téléphone.

Capitalisme quand tu nous tiens :(

title: SCAM
body:
I signed up for this app via an instagram ad and paid £7 for one course. I was then billed £37 in January (which I missed) and £37 in February. Future payments were not clearly noted on the initial order and no email confirmation was sent about future payments. 

Furthermore the app only allows you to manage the subscription via the AppStore but the subscription does not show in AppStore subscriptions so it’s impossible to unsubscribe. 

The owners have refused to refund the payments collected and instead offered to unlock lifetime VIP access for the money already paid. Which I do not want. 

This is clearly an attempt to trick people and scam them out of money. Their operations are illegal under UK consumer law and I have disputed the additional payments with my card provider. 

The majority of reviews on here are too similar to be real. The rest of the reviews like mine are likely the only real ones. AVOID

title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE- SCAM
body:
I cannot give this app 0 stars unfortunately… but DO NOT SUBSCRIBE.
Firstly, the ads for the app are misleading. The app is difficult to use and to navigate and the ads pray on vulnerable people wishing to make genuine improvements in their lives- this is all A SCAM! 
Secondly, there is no option to cancel the subscription in Apple subscriptions as the app/ website suggest. So this is false information. 
Unfortunately, you can only view all the full context of the app after subscription, which I did through a social media platform. So you can’t see all the negative reviews- just the false advertising. I then received loads of spam email after I’d subscribed. Once I realised the app itself did not deliver its promises and was difficult to use I tried to cancel my subscription by emailing the company, I did this within the cancellation window. I emailed asking them to cancel my subscription and confirm no further payments would be taken from my account. However, each month a random payment amount has been taken from my bank. Each month I have emailed and they have refunded but I am 3 months in now and each time I receive the exact same reply email telling me I am unsubscribed and no further payments will be taken… 
I have raised a dispute with my bank and if this is not resolved I will have to go through the ombudsman here in the UK. 
I am not the only user having the issues by the reviews here

title: Suspicious experience – lack of transparency and poor communication
body:
I had a very disappointing experience with Ultiself that raised serious concerns for me.

Firstly, the “Manage App Store Subscription” button in the app does not work. There were no warnings or reminders before the subscription was renewed, and after a £31.04 charge on March 27, I did not receive any invoice or receipt—not from Ultiself, not from Apple.

I’ve been contacting their support daily for over a week, simply asking for an invoice for the payment. Despite several polite emails, I still haven’t received it. Instead, I keep getting promotional messages and offers to stay subscribed.

This behavior feels unprofessional and borderline scammy, especially considering how basic billing transparency is expected from any trustworthy service.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before subscribing. This kind of lack of accountability and evasiveness is unacceptable.

If you value ytransparency and basic respect for users, stay away from this app.

title: Pubblicità ingannevole
body: Quando ho accettato l’offerta proponeva il costo di 6,93 € per un anno. Ho anche fatto uno screenshot come prova. Invece dopo una settimana mi hanno addebitato 39,95 € senza che io sapessi nulla e mi sono reso conto solo un mese dopo quando hanno provato ad addebitarmi lo stesso importo. Ora gli ho scritto per disdire il tutto e sto attendendo un loro riscontro. Sull’app non c’e nessun modo per disdire l’abbonamento e neanche viene spiegato il costo reale del servizio. Inoltre ad oggi non ho neanche ricevuto una mail da parte loro con allegata la fattura di quanto ho pagato e che tipo di servizio ho realmente acquistato. Nel frattempo ho navigato sul web e ho letto molteplici recensioni di persone che hanno avuto il mio stesso problema e a quanto pare l’assistenza clienti non gli ha risposto. Speriamo che a me rispondano. Vi terrò aggiornati sull’evoluzione. Nel frattempo ho avvisato l’assistenza apple che nel caso in cui non ci sarà un rimborso da parte loro provvederanno a prendere provvedimenti a mia tutela, oltre che  a bloccarli sull’apple store.

title: Осторожно: Ultiself — это обман!
body:
Beware: Ultiself is a Scam!

Ultiself — это ловушка для денег, а не приложение для саморазвития.

Купил из-за рекламы в Instagram. Внутри — это пустышка, которая лишь вытягивает деньги. Приложение блокирует выход и агрессивно заставляет покупать дорогие внутренние подписки.

Внимание: списывают деньги несколько раз! Сначала небольшую сумму, а затем, без предупреждения, — намного больше. Это аферистическая схема.

Никогда не покупайте Ultiself! Не верьте их рекламе. Это мошенники.

---

Ultiself is a money trap, not a self-improvement app.

I bought it because of an Instagram ad. Inside, it's just an empty shell designed to extract money. The app blocks your exit and aggressively forces you to buy expensive in-app subscriptions.

Warning: they charge multiple times! First, a small amount, and then, without warning, a much larger one. This is a fraudulent scheme.

Never buy Ultiself! Don't trust their ads. They are scammers.

title: Great support team! Refund processed quickly and without hassle.
body: I came across the Ultiself app through an ad on social media and got curious. The app itself costs money, so I made a purchase. However, I made a mistake because I didn't read the terms and conditions carefully enough and accidentally bought a course for $57. At first, I thought I had been scammed and that I had lost my money. Then I realized I should try to find their customer support first. That's when I got in touch with Nick. I wrote to him explaining exactly what happened in detail. He responded quickly, understood my situation, and was very helpful. A few days later, the money was refunded to me. I am very grateful to the Ultiself team and especially to Nick for this. I haven't had the chance to try the app itself properly yet, but if they have people like this providing support and consultations, then I'm sure the app is in good hands. Everything is fine. Thank you! I hope my feedback will be useful for others.

title: Мошенники!
body:
🇰🇿 Қазақша
⚠️ Алаяқ қосымша! UltiSelf-ке жазылмаңыз! Мен бірнеше рет ақша қайтаруды сұрадым — олар мүлдем жауап бермеді. Бір ай өткен соң, келісімімсіз ақшаны автоматты түрде ала бастады. Apple Pay немесе карта деректерін енгізсеңіз де, бәрібір жалғасады. Тек картаңыздың интернет-транзакцияларын бұғаттау арқылы ғана тоқтата аласыз. Бұл қосымша — таза алаяқтық!

⸻

🇷🇺 Русский
⚠️ ОСТОРОЖНО, МОШЕННИКИ! Никогда не оформляйте подписку на UltiSelf! Я несколько раз писал им с требованием вернуть деньги — полный игнор. Через месяц после оплаты они начали списывать деньги без моего согласия. Неважно, платите через Apple Pay или вводите данные карты — это всё равно продолжится. Остановить можно только полным блокированием интернет-транзакций по карте. Это чистое мошенничество, обходите стороной!

⸻

🇬🇧 English
⚠️ SCAM ALERT! Never subscribe to UltiSelf! I contacted them multiple times requesting a refund — they completely ignored me. One month after payment, they started charging my card without my consent. It doesn’t matter if you use Apple Pay or enter your card details — it will keep happening. The only way to stop it is to block all internet transactions on your card. This is outright fraud — stay away!

title: Скам
body:
По непонятным причинам 3 месяца назад оформилась подписка, сразу же тогда отменил ее и свой аккаунт удалил из приложения а деньги продолжают списываться

Здравствуйте!

Подписка оформляется через стороннюю систему, минуя Apple Store, поэтому стандартные механизмы отмены и контроля подписок от Apple здесь не работают. В самом приложении также нет функции отмены, что делает процесс крайне непрозрачным для пользователей. Даже если аккаунт был удален сразу после оформления, списания продолжаются уже три месяца без какого-либо уведомления или пояснения, за что именно удерживаются средства.

Это очевидная проблема, и мы настоятельно рекомендуем вам разобраться в ситуации и предоставить возможность пользователям отменять подписку так же легко, как они ее оформили. Кроме того, ожидаем оперативного решения по возврату списанных средств.

title: DO NOT GIVE YOUR CARD DETAILS!!!
body:
Incredibly disappointed at how scam-like and misleading the sign up process is for this app! I agreed to the $18 four-week trial period, and I was charged not only that but another $98 as of immediately! I tired to exit the next page which pressures you incessantly to purchase more add-ons (before you even download the app!), of which when I managed to get out of it, another page appeared asking for even more money for another add-on. I saw that as a red flag and immediately shut down the page and checked my bank account but it was too late. They make it incredibly hard to cancel or get help as there is no number you can call, only an email address. I have had to cancel and replace my card which is super annoying. 
This company should be ashamed of their predatory-like sales techniques and it should be illegal. But with loose regulations unfortunately companies like this can continue to use certain tactics to scam unknowing and trusting people out of money. 
If they were honest and upfront and didn’t employ purposefully confusing and near impossible to navigate tactics of what you actually are consenting to, they would be far more reputable as a business. Always do your due diligence before you purchase an app or anything else, even if it comes across as legitimate!! - from someone who learnt the hard way. 
Not worth the stress of having money taken out of your account that you didn’t consent to, even if the app does work to some degree, unless you have tonnes of money to spare and money doesn’t matter to you, and if you don’t mind being taken advantage of.

body:

The app interface is cool on the eyes. Main menu contains 5 items and one should start adding a habit in the daily routine page before you’re able to make use of the others. Zdecydowanie radzę innym, aby byli ostrożni z aplikacją UltiSelf. Mimo że nie miałem aktywnej subskrypcji, aplikacja nadal obciążała mnie automatycznie bez mojej zgody. Jest to całkowicie niedopuszczalne i sprawia wrażenie wprowadzającej w błąd praktyki rozliczeniowej.

Ich obsługa klienta była nieprzydatna, a doświadczenie to spowodowało niepotrzebny stres i frustrację. Zalecam unikanie tej aplikacji, dopóki nie naprawią swojego systemu subskrypcji i płatności.

Oszczędź sobie kłopotów i trzymaj się z dala od UltiSelf

title: BEWARE: Charged for a canceled subscription.
body:
I am writing this review to warn other users. I downloaded this app and decided to try the free trial. Before the trial period was over, I followed the instructions to cancel my subscription through the App Store settings. I received a confirmation that my subscription was canceled.

However, to my complete surprise and frustration, I was charged the full subscription fee. This is unacceptable and feels like a deceptive practice. The purpose of a free trial and a clear cancellation process is to avoid unwanted charges.

I have reached out to support, but have yet to receive a resolution. This is a serious issue that needs to be addressed immediately. Until then, I cannot recommend this app. 

Be careful and check your bank statements if you've ever used this app and tried to cancel your subscription.
author: Piotr Zieliński

title: Підписка на яку я не давала згоди!
body:
Купила одноразову послугу через зовнішнє посилання, але через деякий час побачила спробу зняти з мого рахунку 87 доларів. Жодних листів на email про підписку не було, так само як і підтвердження оплати, навіть тієї першої, на яку я погодилась — що саме по собі є порушенням прав споживача.

Найгірше, що немає жодної можливості керувати підпискою — ні через Play Market, ні в особистому кабінеті в додатку. Підписка невидима, а списання намагаються здійснити автоматично. Написала в підтримку. Чекаю на відповідь, але судячи з відгуків на інших сервісах, такі ситуації масові.

Не рекомендую. Будьте обережні.

Доповнення: це однозначно НЕ НЕПОРОЗУМІННЯ, оскільки Ultoself у якості підтвердження моєї згоди на підписку, скидає скріншот з вікном у якому вже проводиться оплата, і там внизу як додаткова інформація написано що я даю згоду на підписку! Це неподобство, бо до вікна оплати споживач переходить вже коли прийняв рішення про покупку, та був ознайомлений зі всіма умовами. А найголовніше, що оплату я провела через Apple Pay і там взагалі жодної подібної інформації не було.

title: Misleading subscription flow
body:
The app itself might be fine, but the subscription handling is a serious red flag.
I tried to check my active subscriptions via the in-app link — it redirected to the iPhone’s subscription settings, where this app didn’t show up. Naturally, I assumed I wasn’t subscribed.
No renewal reminder, no visible active subscription — and then, suddenly, a charge.
This is not just a poor UX choice — it feels deliberately misleading. If canceling requires emailing support, that should be front and center, not hidden in fine print.
As a paying user, I expect transparency — not unpleasant surprises and manual guesswork.
Still no answer from the support team.

title: Бестолковое приложение
body:
Абсолютно бестолковое приложение. Просто треккер привычек с достаточно запутанным интерфейсом. Есть треккер сна, но все данные надо заносить руками, а почему просто не забирать данные из Apple Health. В итоге надо самому проставить время засыпания, время пробуждения и в отдельном месте поставить галочку, что спал больше 6 часов. Единственный плюс перед другими трекерами - это вечная вечная подписка за 990₽. Но и этот плюс сомнительный. Трекеры за подписку предлагают гораздо более приятные в работе интерфейсы и обладают большим функционалом. 
Основная задача этого условно бесплатного приложения продавать внутри приложения курсы. Которые по сути представляют собой набор рекомендованных привычек.
Однозначно не рекомендую.

title: Не рекомендації
body:
Не рекомендую Ultiself. Після оформлення підписки я зрозумів, що цей сервіс мені не потрібен, і одразу звернувся з проханням скасувати підписку та повернути кошти. Замість нормального вирішення питання підтримка почала затягувати процес і намагатися переконати мене залишитися.

Я не просив жодних «спеціальних пропозицій», додаткових програм чи пояснень — я чітко попросив повернення коштів. Якщо клієнт прямо відмовляється від послуги, нормальна компанія просто оформлює повернення, а не витрачає час на нав’язування своїх продуктів.

Дуже неприємний досвід із підтримкою. Складається враження, що головне для компанії — не задоволення клієнта, а максимально ускладнити процес повернення грошей.

Сподіваюся, Ultiself перегляне своє ставлення до клієнтів.

body:

title: Olha Taranenko
body: Приложение и вообще эта платформа изначально являются мошенничеством. Купила пробный месяц доступа, но чтобы продолжить и получить свой курс, нажала кнопку «продолжить», а в итоге сразу же после первого списания 9,92. $, списало ещё 57$. Поняла, что это развод, через 30 минут написала на их почту для отмены подписки, но тут начались предложения полного доступа, за уже списанные деньги 🤦🏼‍♀️. Написала отказ и настаиваю на возврате средств и отмене отписки. Пока ещё жду хоть какого-то ответа, но хочу предупредить, лучше не устанавливайте и тем более не оплачивайте через applepay или google pay, так как эти платежи потом оформляются как подписка на карту и списываются без вашего ведома. Даже если заблокируете в меню карты эту подписку, то при следующем списании может быть другой терминал, и вы всё равно потеряете свои деньги. Пришлось сразу блокировать карту и удалять её из Apple Pay. Если не вернут деньги в заявленный срок, то это 100% мошенники, о чем я напишу позже. А Разработчику настоятельно рекомендую ответить на моё обращение!

title: Ultiself – scammy subscription trap!
body:
Warning: scammy practices.
They lure you with a $5 trial, but hide in fine print that it auto-renews at $39.99 (or even $97) without clear consent. No proper confirmation, just automatic billing.
When you ask for a refund, they refuse and instead try to “compensate” with random toolkits and courses.
Classic dark-pattern subscription trap – stay away!

—————-

Увага! Дуже сумнівний сервіс.
Обіцяють пробний період за $5, але дрібним шрифтом ховають, що після цього автоматично спишуть $39.99 (або навіть $97). Ніякого явного підтвердження покупки немає — просто ставлять підписку за замовчуванням.
Коли просиш повернути гроші, відмовляють, прикриваючись “політикою”, і замість повернення намагаються впарити якісь “курси” як компенсацію.
Класичний приклад нав’язливих підписок і маніпуляцій — обережно, щоб не потрапити!

title: Stay away from this app
body:
I've been reading recent reviews and realized that I've run into the same issue.

I signed up for a trial through Ultiself’s website using Apple Pay. The app instructs users to manage subscriptions via the App Store — yet no active subscription appears there. There's no clear or accessible way to cancel.

About 14–18 days after signing up, I was charged $49 — with no explanation. I never activated any additional subscriptions within the app. I contacted support immediately after the charge, but have received no response since. Any response!

Now I understand why this app has such a low rating on the App Store — that was a red flag I unfortunately ignored. I strongly advise against downloading this app.

Everything about the experience suggests a highly deceptive setup: misleading subscription handling, no way to cancel, and a complete lack of customer support. Stay away!

title: Troublesome app
body:
UltiSelf is the worst app I’ve ever encountered. It honestly feels like a scam designed to squeeze money out of users. I signed up for a one-week subscription to test whether it would work for me. After just one day, I realized it absolutely didn’t suit my needs.

I decided to cancel the subscription and request a refund, as promised in their ads — “If it’s not for you, we’ll give your money back.” But it turned out you can’t cancel the subscription yourself — you have to email them. I did so, clearly explaining my case and asking for cancellation and a refund.

My message was simply ignored. Instead of addressing my request, they kept replying with new offers — discounts, bonuses, alternative deals — anything but actually helping me. I emailed them every day for a week, repeating my request, but got no meaningful response.

It became obvious that their support was stalling intentionally, waiting for the next billing cycle to hit. I had to block my card to prevent any further charges. Only after that — when they couldn’t withdraw money — did they finally reply, promising a refund within 10 days.

They clearly feel no remorse and do this systematically. Other reviews mention the same scheme. This is a real scam.
author: Brapoel

title: Unfair charges after subscription cancellation – refund requested
body:
I canceled my subscription to Ultiself, but the app continued to charge me even after the cancellation. This is completely unacceptable and feels like a scam. When I tried to request a refund through the App Store, the canceled subscription didn’t even show up under my purchases, which made it impossible to get my money back easily. I demand a full refund for the unauthorized charges and urge others to be very cautious with this app. Apple should investigate this issue and take appropriate action.

title: Beware of scammers!
body:
This app is a total scam. It redirects users to their website, secretly collects payment details, and charges money without clear consent. In my case, they first took $39.95, then secretly charged the same amount again without any notifications!

When I tried to contact support, they blocked my email accounts and deleted all emails from them, making it impossible to reach them. There’s no subscription in the App Store, so you can’t cancel through Apple, making refunds extremely difficult.

This is a classic scam—lure users in, steal their data, and then ignore all refund requests. Do not download this app unless you want to lose your money! Apple should investigate and remove it from the store immediately.

This motivational program truly changed my perspective on my abilities and sense of self-discipline. Previously, I was in a state of inertia; even just getting out of bed seemed like an incredibly daunting task. But thanks to this program, I found the strength and motivation to move forward.

It provided me with a clear purpose and strategies that helped me step by step to actualize myself. Every day, it inspired me to get out of bed with renewed enthusiasm and readiness for achievements. Through regular reminders, positive prompts, and practical tasks, I learned to manage my time and focus on key goals.

title: Cumbersome and clunky.  Terrible customer service
body: I downloaded the trial of this app, tried it, hated it. Didn’t think about it again until I saw a charge for $79 appear on my credit card.  I immediately reached out to them via email (no contact number to call) and they finally responded a week later.  Their initial email, they apologized and asked why I didn’t want to keep the app. It’s cumbersome and just a bunch of extra steps and extra work. Their second email, which came after another week, then proceeds tell me that in their tiny fine print, I agreed to be charged forever unless I notified them to stop.  But they were super cool and cancelled my subscription. (Insert heavy sarcasm). They refused to issue a refund or make this right and only offered a discount on future subscription. If I wanted a subscription I wouldn’t be cancelling in the first place. I run a small business and value customer experience above everything else and refuse to deal with companies who don’t operate the same.

title: Great app, been using for years
body:
As the title says, it’s a consistent app I love to use. 
I’m only giving it 3 stars though because it seems like they really plateaued in the development of features, and there hasn’t been any significant or noticeable improvements in a long time. 
I’d like to see them add a feature where I can choose which day my week starts on ( I prefer Monday to Sunday, and I feel like A LOT of people do too). 
I want them to add 10, heck, even 5 points when you achieve a week goal. 
And they need to fix the stats on specific habits. For example, I have no drinking alcohol for X days and I’ve been hitting my goal 100% or higher, but the stats say I’m only achieving 25%, or less than my weekly goal, and that’s inaccurate. 

TL;DR
Good app in need of improvement. I want accuracy of stats and freshness/innovation of features.

title: App looks clean and for the most part simple to use.
body:
Tried this for about the past week.  Added in my habits I wanted to add to my life and/or track.  Which was simple enough, everything cool.  But the next day I went to check it and clear habits, there were a bunch of other habits that got added.  Some I would have wanted down the road, not quite yet though. 

  Some were ones I didn’t want to do at all.  So I clicked each one and deactivated them.  Thought that was problem solved.  Didn’t know why they were added, but they were gone now.  I log in and check the following day and they were there again.  I didn’t understand and went through all the settings I could look in and couldn’t find anything about the app adding in habits like “suggested” or something by itself.

  I like the way everything is laid out, what features they have.  But adding habits on it’s own and me not being able to change that or find the setting to disable that is a deal breaker for me.  Now I’m not saying that it couldn’t have been user error.  I maybe have done something, I don’t know.  I may try it again in the near future.  I’ll adjust my review accordingly.

title: App Developer Not Focused on Women or BIPOC Folks
body:
When I logged into the app this morning, I got a pop up for an in-app purchase for something called the 4012 challenge. I checked it out. It’s a program to “build confidence” and to bring about your “best self.” The top row of the ad includes photos of three white men, ostensibly the expert PhDs behind the challenge. 
Throughout the ad for the challenge, there were many photos of conventionally attractive white men staring at themselves in the mirror. There was another of a good-looking white man being straddled by a scantily clad white woman in a limo. That’s it. 

No photos of women looking strong. No photos of brown or black people looking confident. Just white dudes. While this is an app I’ve used extensively, when I posted in their “private Facebook group” they refused to approve my post and deleted it. 

So the white alpha app developer app can’t handle constructive criticism. If you’re a white dude who wants to excel, the app developer is targeting you. If you’re female or a black or brown person, forget it. This app developer will happily take your money, but he’s not interested in you or your growth. What a missed opportunity to grow and change (you know, like the app purports to do).

title: Free version is severely handicapped
body:
The app sounds like a great idea, but the free version is handicapped, which prevents me from experiencing and evaluating if the app is actually useful. 

You can only “track” 10 things in the free version. Most of us interested in this app, would like to track easily more than 10 things in any given week. 

So if you want to track your whole day/week to evaluate the app, you can’t. Unless you track less than 10 things. Already at my limit, I was like, “Oh, ok…I guess I won’t add exercise, and language studying…I’m at the limit already”, and that’s just a pointless state to have your customer in, when you want them to evaluate your app. 

This defeats the purpose of the app, as I want to track my DAILY ROUTINES, and productivity, as opposed to ‘just a part of my day’. So I’m never able to evaluate using this for a full day/week, as I need to go to my older app, to continue tracking the rest of my day? That’s silly. 

There is a free-trial for 7 days, but you have to agree to getting charged 40 bucks, and you have to proactively cancel it, to avoid getting charged. That’s just a habit trap and they know it. They’re literally all about habits! lol Like cancelling a gym subscription. You remember you have to cancel the fee tomorrow, or you get charged, but you forget, and by the time you remember, you’ve already been charged. I dislike this. I’d wager this method is a significant portion of their in-app-purchases. 

Recommendation for dev: Give us full use of the app for 7 or 8 days (to get a FULL week of use), after which the app becomes unusable (or it goes back to the 10 tracking limit), if they decide not to proceed further. 

Fwiw, I’m going to continue to try and track the 10 things I have access to try it out, but those are my honest opinions, and first impressions. Now while I evaluate your app with the 10 item limit, I have to use my other tracking app which doesn’t limit me. You’re already on my annoyed side.   ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

title: Free Version is Great
body:
I love the app so far. It’s straight forward and easy to use. 

The only issues I’ve found are that sometimes when you try to remove a habit from your routine, it won’t go away. The only success I’ve had removing a habit has been through multiple app restarts/habit removals. It also seems that habits that aren’t set up to remind you every day still show up on the “My Routine” tab every day. For example, I take probiotics twice weekly, on Monday and Thursday, but today (Tuesday) my “Take Probiotics” habit is showing incomplete. 

I’d love to see habit sorting options in the “My Routine” tab as well. For example, if I want to exercise at 5:30am and read at 6:30am and I have reminders set accordingly,  it’d be great to have an options to sort those habits chronologically to have a better road map for my day. If this could also be implemented in a widget, I’d put it on my Lock Screen to help me stay on track seeing as I, like many, pick up my phone quite often throughout the day.

All in all, I love the app and I hope that the developers will continue improving the UI. I’m definitely considering the premium version as it stands. I’d just like to see some minor quality of life improvements first.

title: Good habit tracker, but many advertised features missing.
body:
This is a good habit tracker, for sure. I like the interface, and how easy it is to use, and it also has everything that you need to keep track of your life quickly and easily. 

The problem is that there were a lot of features mentioned in the advertisement that convinced me to sign up for it that either aren’t there, or that are significantly worse than one would expect. 

For example, I was told that there was a leaderboard for keeping track of different habits, and that you could compete against other people around the world.  That feature just doesn’t exist. 

Also, the “leveling” system is very disappointing.  I reached the platinum rank within a number of days, and no matter how far I go without doing any of my daily habits, it just stays there.  There are no consequences for sleeping in and missing out. 

Also, the AI recommended habits don’t do a good job of explaining to you why certain habits are chosen over others, or of how it determines whether or not they’re working for you.  That was another major selling point for me, but another disappointment. 

All in all, I would recommend this to a friend as a habit tracker, but I wouldn’t recommend it as a life changing piece of software.  It may be worth a one time purchase, but definitely not a subscription.

I feel it’s obvious this whole process is controlled by AI which doesn’t seem to have the ability to spot customer problems in the making and that will charge you less if their first quote doesn’t fool you. Sadly, I fell for it.  Shame on me.  I have demanded a credit based on their 30 day guarantee so we will see if I am forced to report them to AMEX.

Then you check them off daily if you did them. I’m wary of setting push notifications because who wants to be bombarded with pings in their phone all day? title: First Impressions (good and bad) will update
body:
The video on the website sold me on getting this app. Little simplistic for paying $26 considering there’s many apps similar with its functionality and purpose. All it is really is 5 tabs (habit, routine, track habits, dashboard, courses) that’ll you mainly use

Basically it goes like this, choose a habit and learn about it a little bit. Choose a routine that has a collection of habits. Track your habits and just mark the days of the week your doing them. The dashboard would then give you a nice graph of your chosen habits. Once that quickly ends head over to courses tab to be upsold.

There is upselling in the app. It’s to be expected but paying for additional content doesn’t seem worth it partially due to the “Wake Up Without An Alarm” habit they have as one of its first dozen option. The habits description goes into how it’s beneficial and some statistics on sleep patterns. However, the only advice given word for word says

“The first step to reset your brains wiring and gain an incredible mental edge over everyone else is to let your body tell you when to start the day - not your alarm. What about the people in a career field where the day must start at a certain time? There is a solution - can be additional content”

My issues with this statement is 
1. Do y’all not know the solution in the last sentence or are y’all using these habits to bait people into buying more. It’s smart I guess just questionable 
2. There was a lot of words there that could be summed up easily
3. There was ironically a pop up to set a reminder for the habit that encourages me to not wake up with an alarm

Contrary to the negativity

I will say the app is really nice. Smooth to use pretty in color and design and I can tell their being ambitious with their goals as a company. You can definitely learn something from the descriptions and information about the habits offered. 

I would really encourage this app try and make this app more interactive and essential on a day to day basis. Though I’m not 100% satisfied with the purchase but I will keep it as I’m sure it’ll get better

body: I bought the app because it promises to be the best ever!! The graphics  should have been a warning.It is clearly a moneymaking scheme with no insight into real psychology. The courses are presented by the inventer and looks like a zoom meeting!! No extra money spent here. He talks with headphones and microphone to his screen… self praising his own previous ventures… and then…. The app vomits up an overwhelming list of AI generated actions with reminders!!! Hardly anything is free. In app purchases for everything…How you can claim to be better than a great App like fabulous is shocking.!!

body:
The app is great and gives good guidance on why tracking certain things is important. It’s helping me establish a routine until it becomes second nature. The only issue I have is with the notes section. The text disappears often after I’ve captured there - frustrating as I then need to rewrite or else I just don’t put notes down again for that day. It loses impact a little then due to this problem which I hope the developer can sort out. 
Else it’s really fantastic:)
